email.subject: Quick fix for Evergreen Group's site
email.body:
Hi Dev,

I looked at Evergreen Group Heating & Cooling's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call on mobile, so anyone searching for an HVAC fix from their phone has to copy and dial your number manually instead of tapping once. And the page title doesn't mention "Harbor Falls" or "HVAC," which hurts how you show up in local searches.

I fix issues like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
